transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in today?
I feel like people at work are secretly plotting against me, even when they tell me they’re not. It's been making it really hard to do my job, and I just feel so anxious being there lately.
Do you ever hear or see things that other people don’t, or is it mainly the feeling that coworkers are plotting against you?

Yes, I actually do hear things. Pretty often, especially at work or late at night, I hear voices whispering my name and saying I'm screwing up and don't deserve my job. But I also still have this strong gut feeling that my coworkers are trading looks and changing my order tickets to get me fired.

How long have you been having these beliefs that your coworkers are plotting against you and the voices whispering your name? Have they been present for at least a month, or did they start more recently?

Yes, it's definitely been longer than a month. I've been hearing the whispering and feeling like they are plotting against me regularly for about four months now. It got especially noticeable during the recent busy season at the restaurant.

During these four months, have you also had periods of feeling unusually high or irritable with much less need for sleep, racing thoughts, or feeling overly confident or energized? Or have you had a major depression with low mood or loss of interest?

No, I’ve never had times where I felt unusually high, hyper, or had racing thoughts and less need for sleep. But I have completely lost interest and joy in things I used to love, like reading and beach walks, and I mostly just lie on the couch or stare at the plants because I have no energy.

Have these beliefs and voices been the main problem, or have you also had other symptoms like disorganized speech or behavior, very odd behavior, or a major decline in your ability to function at work and in daily life?

Yes, sometimes during a busy rush I'll just freeze up at the server station or start pacing and rearranging the silverware over and over. My work performance has slipped so much that I've been written up and almost fired, and at home I've completely pulled away, leaving my husband to handle all the chores, bills, and socializing.

Have you ever had a period of at least 2 weeks where the depression was clearly present at the same time as the voices and paranoia, or do the voices and beliefs also happen when your mood is not depressed?

I don't really think of it as "depression" but more like just feeling completely drained and losing interest in everything. The voices and paranoid feelings seem to happen regardless of how my mood is, though I'm not entirely sure how to separate them or the exact timing.

Have there been any periods of at least 2 weeks when you felt clearly depressed—sad or hopeless most of the day, nearly every day—while the voices or paranoia were also present? Or do the voices and paranoia happen even when your mood is not depressed?

I don't think I've ever felt deeply sad or hopeless in that specific way, just very empty and drained of energy. The voices and the feelings that people are plotting against me seem to happen regardless of my mood. I'm really not sure how to relate the two or separate them like that.

Have you ever had a clear period of at least 2 weeks where you felt very depressed, sad, or hopeless most of the day nearly every day, while the voices or paranoia were also present? Or do the voices and suspicious feelings happen even when your mood is not depressed?
No, I haven't ever felt that kind of deep, hopeless sadness or depression for a solid two-week block. The voices and the suspicious feelings just seem to happen regardless of how my mood is.
Have you ever had a period of at least 2 weeks when your mood was clearly elevated or very irritable with much less need for sleep, increased energy, racing thoughts, or feeling unusually confident?
No, I’ve never experienced anything like that. I have never had a time where my mood was elevated, or where I had racing thoughts and felt unusually confident or energetic.
Have you noticed any changes like speaking less than usual, having trouble starting or finishing tasks, or feeling emotionally flat or detached from other people?

Yes, I've felt very detached and have almost no energy to do anything anymore. Outside of work, I mostly just lie on the couch or stare at the plants, and I've completely stopped reading or going for beach walks. I also avoid my friends and don't return calls, leaving my husband to handle all of our bills, errands, and social stuff because it's just too much effort.

Have you ever had a period of at least 2 weeks where you felt clearly depressed or lost interest/pleasure in almost everything, and during that same time the voices or paranoid beliefs were still present?

Yes, I have definitely lost interest and pleasure in almost everything I used to love, like reading and beach walks, for over a year now, and that lack of joy has been present during the last four months while dealing with the voices and plotting. I wouldn't say I feel intensely sad or tearful, though. It is more like I feel completely empty, unmotivated, and unable to experience any joy at all.
Have you ever had any period when the voices or paranoia continued for at least 2 weeks while you were not feeling depressed or losing interest in things at all?

It's really hard to separate the two, to be honest. The voices and the feeling that people are plotting against me have mostly been happening around the same time as me losing interest in everything. Because of that, I'm not really sure if there was ever a time I had the voices without those other feelings.
Have the voices or paranoia ever continued for at least 2 weeks when you were not feeling depressed or losing interest in things at all?

No, I haven't had a period like that. The loss of interest and lack of energy started about a year ago and has been constant ever since. Since the voices and paranoia only started four months ago, they have only happened while I was already feeling completely drained and uninterested in things.
Have you ever had a period of at least 2 weeks when you were hearing voices or feeling paranoid, but you were not depressed or losing interest in things at all?

No, I haven't. The loss of interest and pulling away from things started about a year ago, while the voices and paranoia only began around four months ago. Because of that, the voices have only ever happened during this time when I was already feeling completely disconnected and uninterested in things.
Have you ever had a stretch of at least 2 weeks when the voices or suspicious beliefs were present but you were not feeling depressed, empty, or unable to enjoy things at all?

No, I haven't had a period like that. The feelings of emptiness and lack of joy actually started over a year ago, well before the voices and paranoia began about four months ago. Ever since the voices and suspicions started, I have constantly been feeling that way without any break.
Have you ever had at least 2 weeks when the voices or paranoid beliefs were present while you were not feeling depressed, empty, or unable to enjoy things at all?

No, I haven't. Since the empty feelings and loss of interest started over a year ago, and the voices only began four months ago, I've never had the voices without also feeling that way. They have always overlapped.
Have you ever had any period of at least 2 weeks when the voices or suspicious beliefs were present while you were not feeling depressed, empty, or unable to enjoy things at all?

No, I really haven't had a time like that. Because the emptiness and loss of joy started over a year ago and the voices only began four months ago, they have always overlapped. I have never had the voices without already feeling that way.
Have you ever had any period of at least 2 weeks when the voices or suspicious beliefs were present while you were not feeling depressed, empty, or unable to enjoy things at all?

No, I haven't had a period like that at all. The emptiness and lack of joy started over a year ago and have been constant, while the voices only began four months ago. So, the voices have only ever happened while I was already feeling completely drained and unable to enjoy things.
During the past year, have there been any times when your low mood or loss of interest improved for at least 2 weeks while the voices and suspicious beliefs were still present?

I'm not really sure, but I haven't noticed any period like that where my lack of interest got better while the voices and suspicious feelings stayed. These struggles have just felt pretty constant and overwhelming overall.
Have there been any periods of at least 2 weeks when the voices or suspicious beliefs were present while your depression or loss of interest was not happening at all?
I'm not really sure about that. I haven't really thought about the exact timing of when they might have occurred separately. Everything has just felt so overwhelming and mixed together lately.
To help me sort this out, was there ever a clear 2-week period when you were hearing voices or feeling paranoid, but you were not having the low mood, emptiness, or loss of interest at the same time?

No, there hasn't been a time like that. The loss of interest and pulling away from my routines started first, about a year ago, whereas the voices and paranoia only began about four months ago. Since the voices and paranoia started, I've consistently felt that lack of motivation and joy, so they've never happened without those feelings.
